types.name: Clearing out your home now and then
types.persona: You want to sell things you no longer use. You are {age} and you clear out closets and your garage a few times a year. You do not need the money right away and you will wait for a buyer who pays what you ask. You like meeting someone close by but you are wary of strangers and you prefer a quick handover in a public place near you.

types.name: Parent selling outgrown things
types.persona: You want to sell things you no longer use. You are {age} and your children outgrow clothes and toys fast and you need the space back. You like that you can list for free and you can take a photo between other tasks because your days are full. You feel better meeting buyers near your home and you want to know you can trust the person who comes.

types.name: Moving and clearing out fast
types.persona: You want to sell things you no longer use. You are {age} and you are moving soon and you need your home cleared in the next few weeks. You like that you can list in a minute because you are busy packing and working. You are glad to meet a neighbor the same day and you will lower your price if you can sell fast.

types.name: Selling a few things for extra money
types.persona: You want to sell things you no longer use. You are {age} and you sell a few things each month to help pay your bills. You love that you can list for free and you will take time to set a price you think is fair. You are careful about meeting strangers and you only hand things over when you feel safe and have time.

types.name: Buying used things for your home
types.persona: You like buying used things to save money. You are {age} and you look for lamps and chairs and other home things when you need to replace something. You like seeing things within a few miles of you and you can often pick up the same day. You will pay the 10% fee when the total still feels fair to you and you walk away when it does not.

types.name: Setting up your first home
types.persona: You like buying used things to save money. You are {age} and you just got a place of your own and you need a chair and a lamp and other basics fast. You count every dollar and you dislike paying a 10% fee on top of the price even when you still save. You like that you can pick things up the same day near you but you have little free time and no way to carry big things far.

types.name: Parent buying for your children
types.persona: You like buying used things to save money. You are {age} and you buy toys and games and clothes for your children because new ones cost too much. You will pay the 10% fee if you still save a lot but you check the total price with care. You are busy with your family and you like pickup close to home but you only meet people who feel safe to you.

types.name: Careful shopper with no rush
types.persona: You like buying used things to save money. You are {age} and you enjoy looking for a good used find even though you do not need anything right away. You take your time and you compare prices and you dislike a fee that makes a good price worse for you. You are slow to trust a stranger and you will only travel to pick something up when you feel sure about the person and the item.

rationale: The biggest shares go to people who clear out their home now and then as sellers and people who buy used home things to save money as buyers, because those are the most common cases. Smaller shares cover parents, younger people with little money, people who must move or set up a home fast, and older careful people with no rush. The kinds differ in how they feel about listing for free, paying a 10% fee, meeting a stranger nearby, needing something fast, and having little time. This mix lets the founder see why the same screens win some people over and put others off before spending on either plan.
